evidence.description: ## When to Choose Under-Construction If you are an investor, a buyer looking at a 3-5+ year horizon, or you are comfortable waiting in exchange for better pricing and higher appreciation, under construction projects in Pune make sense. You lock in a good price now, benefit from phased payments, and ride the infrastructure and market up-cycle. Trusted developers like Aishwaryam Group also launch newer projects with modern amenities, smart-home features and great design, giving you a strong under-construction option. However, you must check: RERA registration & possession timeline Financial health of the developer Scope for cost escalation or market slow-downs Under-construction has more upside but also more moving parts. ## Pune Market Insight (2025 Update) [...] ## Understanding the Two Options Ready Possession Flats in Pune mean that the project is completed (or nearly completed), has obtained its Occupation Certificate (OC) or is ready for hand-over. This offers immediate occupancy or rental income. According to a guide, ready-possession flats offer “zero wait time, no GST (with OC), and instant rental income” in Pune’s 2025 market. Each path serves different goals, immediate convenience versus long-term capital appreciation. This blog will walk you through the pros and cons of both options, use credible market data, and show how trusted developers like Aishwaryam Group are offering choices in both categories to help you make an informed decision.
